# SdkInfo

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · static class

```csharp
public static class SdkInfo
```

Version information about this SDK.

## Constants

### MajorVersion

```csharp
public const int MajorVersion = 1;
```

The major SDK version. A change here means plugins must be rebuilt.

### ProtocolVersion

```csharp
public const int ProtocolVersion = 1;
```

Version of the protocol AutoSettings uses to talk to a plugin host. Plugins never use it directly; it is exchanged when a plugin starts so that mismatched versions fail with a clear message.

### Version

```csharp
public const string Version = "1.0.0";
```

The SDK version (semantic versioning). Plugins declare the major version they were built for in `plugin.yaml` (`sdk: "1.0"`). AutoSettings loads plugins whose SDK major version it supports.
